review.notes: Full diff of the OCR against extracted text from all 47 physical PDF pages, with a per-page numeric multiset check (all apparent losses traced to the Figure 1 hero panel on p.1 and chart-internal axis labels on pp.9/17/33/34, all embedded as images). Code fences balanced; heading tree matches the PDF outline including the printed 'Coding Capability and Experience' / 'General Agent Experience' paragraph headings; 16 Figure and 5 Table captions present with sub-panel images sharing captions; references [1]-[152] all present. Physical p.1 (footnote), p.8 (equations/figures), p.37 (DOI/URL references) were rendered and visually inspected; Table 2/Table 5 header text was verified in the extracted page text. Spaced-digit and subscript checks over equations found no defects (e.g. beta_1=4 / beta_2=25 in Section 2.3.2 match the printed text).
